verdict.rationale: Penpot ships an official, self-hostable MCP server plus an open plugin API, REST API with access-token auth, and webhooks, explicitly marketed for AI agents to build against (penpot-docs-1,3,5,6,19,27,31,32,39). This gives AI-native users concrete official SDK/API surfaces to integrate with, though there's no independent hands-on validation of the MCP server and the OpenAPI spec could not be located (probe 404s), missing for 10: independent developer confirmation of MCP/plugin SDK reliability, discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/llms.txt spec.
